collection.description: A sign demands one coconut from every household for Biggles.

premise.name: The premise
premise.text: Someone leaves a sign demanding one coconut from every household 'for Biggles.'

a.name: Answer A
a.text: The culprit is a hungry child; the village addresses the need and the prank.

c.name: Answer C
c.text: A second sign appears: 'Biggles accepts apologies.'

b__fx.name: Answer B
b__fx.text: The coconuts are collected for a feast, but nobody learns who wrote the sign.

b__text.name: Answer B
b__text.text: The coconuts are collected for a feast, but nobody learns who wrote the sign.
